title: Super Spooktacular

facts.statement: October 2010 was Super Spooktacular month, with spooky Community events planned every Thursday afternoon and Friday morning.
facts.quote: October is Super Spooktacular month! It's a time for ghosts and costumes and trick or treats.

facts.statement: October's Super Spooktacular featured spooky community events run by the community team every Thursday afternoon and Friday morning that month.
facts.quote: este mes habrá eventos espeluznantes realizados por el equipo comunitario todos los jueves por las tardes y los viernes por la mañana

facts.statement: During October's Super Spooktacular, community spooky events ran every Thursday afternoon and Friday morning.
facts.quote: este mes habrá eventos espeluznantes realizados por el equipo comunitario todos los jueves por las tardes y los viernes por la mañana

facts.statement: The second year of the Super Spooktacular Halloween festival returned to Free Realms, bringing back the previous year's fun plus more.
The second annual Super Spooktacular Halloween festival returned, bringing back the previous year's fun and horror.
A Trick or Treat party in Sanctuary celebrated the second anniversary of the Super Spooktacular edition of Free Realms.
facts.quote: conmemorando el segundo aniversario de la edición Super Spooktacular

facts.statement: Super Spooktacular 2013 was the fourth annual Halloween event in Free Realms, starting October 1 and running through November 12, 2013.
facts.quote: It's our Fourth Annual Super Spooktacular and you're invited to try out loads of great quests, costumes, decorations and more.

facts.statement: During Super Spooktacular, players could take part in spooky activities, festive live events, quests, costumes and decorations.
facts.quote: Once again we're celebrating Halloween in Free Realms with spooky activities and festive live events!

facts.statement: The article is titled 'Free Realms Super Spooktacular 09' and was posted October 19, 2009; it concerns the Halloween-season event, but its body text was not captured.
facts.quote: Free Realms Super Spooktacular 09 Posted October 19th, 2009 by Medawky

facts.statement: Free Realms held its first Halloween-themed event, Super Spooktacular, which was scheduled to run from October 14 through November 11, 2009.
facts.quote: Super Spooktacular is scheduled to run from October 14th through November 11th.

facts.statement: The Free Realms Halloween event offered decorations, costumes, mini-games and daily in-game trick-or-treating.
facts.quote: The event offers decorations, costumes, mini-games and even daily in game trick or treating.

facts.statement: SOE's Andy Sites described the Free Realms Halloween event as weeks of spooky activities and festive live events, and said players could dress as costumes such as a chicken, mummy or witch.
facts.quote: We are celebrating the first Halloween in Free Realms, with weeks of spooky activities and festive live events

facts.statement: The October 2011 webcast discussed the Spooktacular event in Free Realms.
facts.quote: talk about the always fun and frightening Spooktacular event in Free Realms

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community-event news post for October 2010's Super Spooktacular month. It announces a Ghostly Pet Party in the Blackspore swamp on two server-1 time slots (Thursday October 7 and Friday October 8, 2010), and explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar. The post date is not shown; the page says it was posted 4 days, 9 hours before capture.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta para Mascotas Fantasma (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice for the Super Spooktacular in October 2010: a Ghost Pet Party held in a hidden spot in the swamp, with two scheduled server-1 runs (Thursday 7 October 2010 and Friday 8 October 2010). It also describes the weekly community-event rhythm and how players find events through the Game Guide calendar.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta para Mascotas Fantasma (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE community event notice for the Super Spooktacular (October 2010): a Ghost Pet Party held at a hidden spot in the Sporeshade swamp area, on Server 1. It gives the event times for the Americas and for UK/Europe and explains how to reach community events through the Game Guide calendar. The page's posting date is not shown; the event dates are 7-8 October 2010.

article_summaries.title: Segundo Año de Super Spooktacular (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language Free Realms news post announcing the second year of the Super Spooktacular Halloween event. It covers costumes, Pixiewood decorations, the /scare trick-or-treat mechanic, daily quests, world events, the Bone Marsh battle instance, and a Trading Card Game (JCC) Halloween pack offer. The post's date is not shown; it is only given as 'posted 7 months, 2 weeks ago' at the 2011-06-04 capture, so it is roughly late 2010.

article_summaries.title: Segundo Año de Super Spooktacular (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing the second year of the Super Spooktacular Halloween event. It describes costumes, decorations, a /scare trick-or-treat system, daily quests, world and community events, the Bone Bog Cemetery battle instance, and a Trading Card Game (JCC) Halloween pack. The post gives no exact date; it was captured in June 2011 and says it was posted about 7 months and 2 weeks earlier.

article_summaries.title: Evento Comunitario: Fiesta de Truco o Trato en Santuario
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event notice (captured under the 'What is New?' page) announcing a Trick or Treat party in Sanctuary to celebrate the second anniversary of the Super Spooktacular edition. It gives the event dates and server (Server 1) for the US/Latin America and UK/Europe sessions in October 2010. The article's own posting date is not shown; only the event dates are given.
